title: design_canonical/1: the canonical bytes of a design and their SHA-256
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample design canonical`: the design/1 in canonical form (keys in alphabetical order, factors sorted by name, batches by SHA-256 then file: equal designs give equal bytes), the count of those bytes and their SHA-256, which `prov/1` records. `--out` writes the bare canonical design/1 plus a final newline. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/design_cmd.rs.

sha256.description: of the canonical JSON without the final newline
